# Mahir Yavuz

> Engineering and product leader. Teacher and advisor. Turning data into products since 1998. Head of Engineering at AirOps. The homepage has his bio and his experiments, a new one some days, with the latest on view; every experiment has its own page.

Head of Engineering at AirOps. Before that, Mahir was Head of Engineering for Search, Recommendations and Ads at Etsy, co-founder and CTO of Topos, Director of Data Science at R/GA and Senior Researcher at Ars Electronica Futurelab in Linz, and his teams have taken on data problems for companies including Nike, SAP, Siemens, PwC, Google and Microsoft. He has taught since 2003, at schools including Columbia University, the University of Pennsylvania, Pratt, the University of Art and Design Linz and Istanbul Bilgi University, with guest lectures at MIT, NYU and SVA. At Columbia Engineering he lectures on Business Applications of LLMs and Product Management with AI. His work has been shown at the Ars Electronica Festival, SIGGRAPH, ISEA, the Istanbul Biennial and elsewhere, and he has spoken at events such as TEDx Istanbul and Vienna, Microsoft Build, Google Cloud Next, Visualized and the Fast Company Innovation Festival. He publishes a new data visualization every day at casualdata.com.

## Experiments

- [No. 013 · Turkish, suffix by suffix](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/013/) (13 Nov 2026): A Turkish word grows a suffix at each tap, from Çekoslovakya to 44 letters, while the English under it grows from one word into a sentence; four words to build, and a change of root changes the vowels of every suffix.
- [No. 012 · Ebru, sheet by sheet](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/012/) (12 Nov 2026): A marbler’s tray seen from above: drop the colours, draw them back and forth, comb them, then lay a sheet of paper on the water and keep the sheet as a picture.
- [No. 011 · A piano, tuned by ear](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/011/) (11 Nov 2026): One octave of a grand piano’s strings, each a little flat, tuned in the tuner’s own order: turn the lever on a pin until the beat between two notes slows to the right pace, then move to the next string.
- [No. 010 · The S&P 500, by weight](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/010/) (9 Nov 2026): Every company’s share of the S&P 500 from 1995 to 2026, stacked by rank: the twenty largest drawn one by one as they rise and fall, with all 500 a click away.
- [No. 009 · The midterm tide](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/009/) (4 Nov 2026): Every US midterm since 1790 set against 2026: what the record said before the vote, the results as they were called, and state-by-state maps since 1978.
- [No. 008 · Philosophy, mind to mind](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/008/) (3 Nov 2026): Who drew on whom in 2,600 years of philosophy, from Thales to Judith Butler, as one chart that plays its own lines through time; tap a thinker to light their lineage.
- [No. 007 · Iznik, plate by plate](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/007/) (31 Oct 2026): Ottoman Iznik dishes painted on a 3D plate in workshop order, outline, cobalt, turquoise, green and red, then glazed, a new pattern every time.
- [No. 006 · New York, interlocked](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/006/) (30 Oct 2026): New York neighborhoods drawn stroke by stroke in nested block letters, short letters held in the arms of tall ones, in pairs of colors after Josef Albers, a new name every 15 seconds.
- [No. 005 · The year in relief](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/005/) (29 Oct 2026): A well-known S&P 500 company’s last year of closing prices as a mountain range, a new company every visit, with the weather set by how the year went.
- [No. 004 · Istanbul, piece by piece](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/004/) (28 Oct 2026): An isometric Istanbul where the Bosphorus, the Golden Horn and the Marmara meet, rebuilt landmark by landmark as each one raises its neighborhood.
- [No. 003 · Manhattan sundial](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/003/) (27 Oct 2026): An abstract model of Manhattan lit by the sun where it stands over New York at this minute; drag through the day and the year, or jump to the next Manhattanhenge.
- [No. 002 · Self-portrait in type](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/002/) (26 Oct 2026): The original homepage as a full screen of type: the page’s own text runs across it as one line, wound in a spiral from an eye, and sets a face that turns toward the pointer; click to spill the type and wind it again from there, or type to set it in your own words.
- [No. 001 · Self-portrait in latent space](https://mahiryavuz.com/works/001/) (26 Oct 2026): A career as a cloud of points that searches itself under the cursor and gathers into a face when the name is clicked.

## Talks and press

The same list, with dates, is a page of its own: https://mahiryavuz.com/press/

### Talks

- [New Way Now: Etsy keeps human connection at the heart of commerce with Google Cloud AI](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yUK4XUggdQw) (Google Cloud, 11 Jul 2025): Google Cloud’s film on how Etsy uses AI in search and discovery, with Mahir interviewed.
- [Five lessons Etsy learned building on Microsoft AI | BRK258](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dvC4dK9c7nQ) (Microsoft, 24 May 2024): Session at Microsoft Build 2024, given with colleagues from Etsy and Microsoft.
- [The New Real: Experiental AI and the AI Lab](https://ars.electronica.art/keplersgardens/en/experiental-ai/) (Ars Electronica, 10 Sep 2020): Panel at the Ars Electronica Festival 2020 with Jake Elwes, Caroline Sinders and Anna Ridler, moderated by Drew Hemment.
- [Speak to the Eyes - Mahir Yavuz | Studio-X Istanbul](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RanjusPDRqk) (Columbia GSAPP, 8 Jun 2017): Talk on data visualization at Studio-X Istanbul.
- [Chemistry of Intelligence / Ars Electronica 2016 / FIS Stage](https://vimeo.com/199769134) (Ars Electronica, Sep 2016): Talk at the Ars Electronica Festival 2016 in Linz.
- [Data Visualization Projects for Cities and Citizens](https://www.nyc.gov/site/cidi/about/innovation-lecture-series.page) (NYC CIDI, 2 Jun 2016): Lecture in the Innovation Lecture Series of New York City’s Center for Innovation through Data Intelligence.
- [Who will govern "smart" cities? | Mahir Yavuz | TEDxViennaSalon](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gY36Sm2uI6k) (TEDx Talks, 9 Jul 2015): Talk at TEDxVienna’s CityX salon.
- [Veri arayan adam: Mahir Yavuz at TEDxReset 2014](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=U1D6aZTfhS8) (TEDx Talks, 1 Jun 2014): TEDx talk in Istanbul, “The man seeking the data”. In Turkish.

### Podcasts

- [That custom gift for your mom takes more work than you think](https://stackoverflow.blog/2025/07/29/that-custom-gift-for-your-mom-takes-more-work-than-you-think/) (Stack Overflow, 29 Jul 2025): The Stack Overflow Podcast, on the engineering behind Etsy’s marketplace.
- [Adaptasyon](https://manifold.press/diziler/adaptasyon-podcast) (Manifold, 2016–2020): A podcast on new technology that Mahir made with Onur Akmehmet. In Turkish.
- [081 | The Hustle with Mahir Yavuz and Jan Willem Tulp](https://datastori.es/81-the-hustle-with-mahir-yavuz-and-jan-willem-tulp/) (Data Stories, 25 Aug 2016): Data Stories episode 81, on the business side of data visualization.
- [Inspiration or Plagiarism? w/ Bryan Connor and Mahir Yavuz](https://datastori.es/data-stories-23-inspiration-or-plagiarism/) (Data Stories, 30 May 2013): Data Stories episode 23, with Bryan Connor of The Why Axis.

### Press

- [Preparing Engineers for an AI-Driven World](https://www.engineering.columbia.edu/about/news/preparing-engineers-ai-driven-world) (Columbia Engineering, 16 Feb 2026): On Columbia Engineering’s AI workshops, among them Mahir’s Product Management with AI.
- [Maps, pandemics, and reckoning with history](https://penntoday.upenn.edu/news/maps-pandemics-and-reckoning-history) (Penn Today, 10 Aug 2020): On mapping at Penn, with Mahir on the COVID-19 data compiler that Topos built.
- [Topos Utilizes A.I. to Understand Cities and Map Micro-Neighborhoods](https://www.inverse.com/article/46287-transforming-data-collection-with-artificial-intelligence) (Inverse, 8 Jul 2018): On how Topos reads cities with machine learning, with Mahir and co-founder Will Shapiro.
- [How one data-driven art and technology company is understanding cities with AI](https://www.storybench.org/one-data-driven-art-technology-company-understanding-cities-ai/) (Storybench, 3 Nov 2017): A write-up of Mahir’s talk on Topos at Northeastern University.
- [Here’s How N.Y.C.’s Five Boroughs Should Really Be Defined](https://www.fastcompany.com/90131540/this-startup-used-ai-to-redefine-n-y-c-s-five-boroughs-for-today) (Fast Company, 29 Jun 2017): On Topos, which used AI to redraw New York’s five boroughs.
- [Sense of Patterns](https://www.metalocus.es/en/news/sense-patterns) (Metalocus, 24 Oct 2011): On Sense of Patterns, Mahir’s series of printed data visualizations.
- [Newsknitter](https://makezine.com/article/craft/newsknitter/) (Make:, 5 Sep 2007): On News Knitter, made with Ebru Kurbak, which knits the day’s headlines into sweaters.
- [Etsy: Connecting nearly 90 million buyers with special items using gen AI and "algotorial curation"](https://cloud.google.com/customers/etsy-ai) (Google Cloud): Google Cloud’s customer story on Etsy, which quotes Mahir.

### Papers and essays

- [Efficient Large-Scale Visual Representation Learning And Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13399) (arXiv, 22 May 2023): Paper with colleagues at Etsy on visual representation learning at scale.
- [adSformers: Personalization from Short-Term Sequences and Diversity of Representations in Etsy Ads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.01255) (arXiv, 2 Feb 2023): Paper with colleagues at Etsy on personalizing Etsy Ads from a shopper’s recent activity.
- [Rethinking ‘distance’ in New York City](https://medium.com/topos-ai/rethinking-distance-in-new-york-city-d17212d24919) (Topos, 10 Apr 2017): Essay with Will Shapiro on new ways to understand a city’s neighborhoods.
- [News Knitter](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/1667265.1667298) (ACM, 2009): Paper with Ebru Kurbak on News Knitter.

### Art projects

- [Orkan Telhan & Mahir M. Yavuz: United Colors of Dissent](https://vimeo.com/106298010) (ARTE Creative, 16 Sep 2014): Short film on United Colors of Dissent, from the Connecting Cities series.
- [United Colors of Dissent](https://www.connectingcities.net/projects/united-colors-dissent/) (Connecting Cities, 2 Sep 2013): A data-driven performance for public screens, made with Orkan Telhan.
- [Work 2007–2011](https://casualdata.com/work/) (casualdata, 2007–2011): Mahir’s own archive of News Knitter, Value Machine, Newshaper, Social Bits and Sense of Patterns.
